scope: Systematic repository-wide final development review: complete artifact inventory, high-risk current module/interface inspection, legacy claims/boundary review, executable verification and advisory scans. Not an independent line-by-line flight acceptance inspection.

findings.title: Known dependency advisories in locked development software
findings.mission_consequence: Advised framework/library versions can expose build/development systems; deployment should not retain them.
findings.corrective_action: Upgrade Astro to 7.3.8, cryptography to 50.0.2 and pytest to 9.1.1; retain frozen lockfiles and advisory gates.
findings.closure_criteria: Both current active-environment advisory reports have zero findings; retest production builds/signatures.

findings.title: Shared or zero operational verification-key configuration was allowed
findings.mission_consequence: One compromised authority could sign both commands and flight images.
findings.corrective_action: Reject shared keys in ARM CMake, service and serial sender; reject nonempty zero keys.
findings.closure_criteria: Four invalid ARM configurations rejected; HTTP and sender reject before any transport; independent key custody/security review remains open.

findings.title: C and Python firmware acceptance differed
findings.mission_consequence: An image accepted by one interface could be rejected or unsafe at boot.
findings.corrective_action: Require canonical erased manifest padding and a stack pointer above SRAM start in the MCU validator.
findings.closure_criteria: C/Python padding/vector regressions pass; actual flash/ECC/boot HIL remains open.

findings.title: Ground counter range and HTTP precision did not match the wire protocol
findings.mission_consequence: Large replay floors could exhaust the ground sender prematurely or lose precision in the browser.
findings.corrective_action: Migrate SQLite signing counters atomically to decimal text; preserve uint64 HTTP nonces as strings; reserve terminal sequence for retirement and report exhaustion without an internal error. Record the exact signed frame, parameters and public signer identity in HTTP/update/serial command histories without logging private keys or bearer tokens.
findings.closure_criteria: Signed-range migration, concurrent reservations, exact high counter, restart, exhaustion and terminal retirement pass. The archived SET_MODE frame is reconstructed and its signature/parameters verified by a regression test.

findings.title: Historical validation assertions only logged invalid inputs
findings.mission_consequence: Null pointers and invalid indices could reach dereferences or array accesses in host support.
findings.corrective_action: Add type-correct explicit null/range returns in five modules, current scenario tests and a 24-source Cppcheck gate; resolve assertion macro redefinitions.
findings.closure_criteria: Compatible historical-host scenarios pass; standard scan has no diagnostics; legacy code remains outside the current flight baseline.

findings.title: Static website was not deployable at a project URL
findings.mission_consequence: Broken assets/routes and a console without its required local service would make the public mission unusable.
findings.corrective_action: Generate base-aware URLs, static evidence/research pages, local-console guidance and source downloads; validate all local assets/anchors; publish only read-only static files.
findings.closure_criteria: Project-path build and link checker pass; verify Pages build, live asset hashes and desktop/mobile navigation.

findings.title: Residual classification/compliance claims in historical code comments
findings.mission_consequence: Readers could mistake legacy host scaffolding for accepted NASA flight implementation.
findings.corrective_action: Mark the legacy C/Python modules explicitly, preserve the old payload README and make protocol-v2 bridge the current entry point.
findings.closure_criteria: Legacy artifacts inventoried as historical; formal classification/tailoring and independent review remain unaccepted.

findings.title: Build caches and stale source archives could enter publication
findings.mission_consequence: An unreproducible or outdated archive could undermine public engineering claims.
findings.corrective_action: Exclude Astro/TypeScript caches, verify exact current source/artifact digests and ZIP contents before publishing, and test tamper/missing-source/acceptance/key rejection.
findings.closure_criteria: Current source tree, ZIP CRCs, manifest and checksums must agree; operational key paths and unsupported acceptance fail publication.

findings.title: Watchdog decision preceded the boot-confirmation flash phase
findings.mission_consequence: A late or failed boot-state write could escape the cycle deadline decision.
findings.corrective_action: Recheck the runtime deadline after boot confirmation; a boot read/write failure latches unhealthy storage and prevents watchdog feeding.
findings.closure_criteria: Repeated runtime deadline regression, ARM build/compiler analysis; actual boot-write timing and watchdog reset remain HIL gates.

publication_evidence: output/verification/publication.json (generated after publication; not flight evidence)
